Woman climbs mobile tower over relationship and legal disputes

In separate incidents, two women climbed mobile towers. One in Bagaha climbed after refusing to stay with her husband following a love marriage. Another in Lucknow, a differently-abled student, climbed a tower to protest the alleged failure to arrest a rape accused. Both women were safely brought down by the police.
